content.text: (c) Using SST, remove the companion flange.

content.description: Diagram showing removal of oil seal and oil slinger using SST tool

content.text: 11. REMOVE OIL SEAL AND OIL SLINGER
(a) Using SST, remove the oil seal from the housing.

content.description: Diagram showing removal of front bearing and bearing spacer using SST tool

content.text: 12. REMOVE FRONT BEARING AND BEARING SPACER
(a) Using SST, remove the front bearing from the housing.
If the front bearing is damaged or worn, replace the bearing.

content.description: Diagram showing differential case and ring gear with matchmarks indicated on bearing cap and differential carrier

content.text: 13. REMOVE DIFFERENTIAL CASE AND RING GEAR
(a) Place matchmarks on the bearing cap and differential carrier.

content.description: Diagram showing removal of side bearing preload adjusting plate washers using SST tool

content.text: (c) Remove the two side bearing preload adjusting plate washers with SST.
NOTE: Measure the adjusting plate washer and note the thickness.
